**最后验证 2026-08-14**：
远端侧，本机 Windows + Node v24.9.0 对远端 OpenCloudOS 9.4 + Node v24.9.0，经 SSH 隧道跑通跨机对话

- 私密报告：请通过 GitHub Issue
s 提交（标注 `[security]`），或直接联系维护者 @Asaiuta；修复前不会公开细节。
## 架构
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**实时通道**：每条远端链路的 mux/host WS 帧经 `HubEventBus` fan-out 到本地 SSE `/hub/events`；浏览器按 `event.seq` 与历史基线去重
（打开会话先拉尾部历史，live 事件缓冲后按 `seq > tailSeq` 应用），`assistant/chunk` 增量折叠逐 token 气泡，审批/提问帧到达即上卡；SSE 断线自动重连。
导入会话的树变化（新增、移除、转正隐藏）由 hub 帧 watcher 以 host 帧经同一通道推给官方工作区运行时。
## What this is
DSH's session tree only knows sessions created on this machine by this tool. So:
A job half-finished on a server needs a new tab, a tunnel, and a hunt through logs. Close the laptop

and come
back — no idea where it is now. A plan you discussed with Codex CLI last week does not exi

st in DSH at all;
you go dig through the JSONL files under `~/.codex`.
This plugin brings both kinds of sessions into the same tree:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Open any session — remote included — and the official conversation pane renders it as usual: history

,
token-by-token streaming, approval cards, question forms. All official components. The plugin only

moves data;
it draws no UI.
Remote sessions are not proxied locally. The agent loop runs inside that machine's own `dsh`; your m

achine is
just a dashboard. Close the laptop and grab lunch; when you come back, if the session is s

till running the live
stream picks up from the current moment, and if it already finished you see th

ive
stream picks up from the current moment, and if it already finished you see the complete result.

## What it accesses
It reads your local session logs (per tool, as you authorize), talks to the servers you configure, a

nd never
touches your project files.
Every item below happens only while its feature is enabled: with the importer off no logs are read;

with
aggregation off no outbound connections are made.
Full list (files / network / credentials / session content)

**File access**:
- Reads/writes `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-session-hub.json` (`0600`, atomic: tmp + rena

me);
- Reads/writes `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-session-hub-imports.json` (imported-session parse cache,

/projects/**/*.jsonl`, `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db` (SQLite opened read-only),
`~/.pi/agent

/sessions/**/*.jsonl`, to build **read-only** imported session views; never written back.

per tool, manually**: a tool you have not clicked **Import** for is never read.
